title: Almond Star Steamie Cakes
description: Moist and delicious vegan cakes made with almond flour, perfect for a snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: Non-dairy milk
ingredients.notes: such as almond or soy milk

instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°F (180°C) and grease a muffin tin with coconut oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the almond flour, star anise, steamie sugar, and baking powder.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the non-dairy milk, apple cider vinegar, and melted coconut oil.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until well combined.
Divide the batter evenly among the muffin cups.
Bake for 18-20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center of a cake comes out clean.
Allow the cakes to cool in the tin for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
